I wrote `fee(order)` in `/work/shipping.py`. All 6 cases in `examples.json` match the expected amounts.

Because the examples only cover simple orders, I also checked one complicated order by working it out by hand. The code gave the same result, 51,240원. That order used jeju, 40,000g, items 25 and a 2025-12-27 (Saturday) date. It also had gold membership, fragile, and a NOWKND coupon outside its date range. Together it covered:
- splitting into 3 boxes, with the leftover gram going to the first box
- weight fees in both bands, plus the large-box fee
- island free shipping, with the gold discount capped at 3,000원
- the weekend surcharge, with the fragile surcharge capped at 3,000원
- peak-season pricing

Two points where the spec could be read either way:
- **Dates:** coupon periods and holidays are checked against the exact year 2025. Peak season is checked by month and day only, so it applies in any year.
- **Coupons:** they are compared case-sensitively, and any other value, or a missing coupon, has no effect.
